paragraphs: Ieodo is a submerged reef 149 km southwest of Marado. For generations it has been spoken of as a mythical island—rising white like a dream through the waves, a thousand ri south beyond the sea.
Stories of what unfolds on that island—Seong-woo, nature, goblins, walls. I came to learn that even in the place I fled to, there is paradise.
A journey with Seong-woo in search of something that is ours.
